item.title: UK will send 1,000 missiles to Ukraine this winter
item.body: The missiles are intended to help Ukraine defend itself against Russia. The funding forms part of the overall £500 million military package announced in the Budget.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🚀 UK will send 1,000 missiles to Ukraine this winter

The missiles are intended to help Ukraine defend itself against Russia. The funding forms part of the overall £500 million military package announced in the Budget.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 17 November, 17:50
